displayProperties.description: Improve this aspect of your Chalice to obtain and use new types of runes.
displayProperties.name: Rune Compatibility

displayProperties.description: Improve this aspect of your Chalice to maximize powerful gear drops from the final chest in the Menagerie.
displayProperties.name: Power and Efficiency

displayProperties.name: Ghost Cosmetics

displayProperties.description: Options to change the behavior and challenge of the Nightfall.
displayProperties.name: Nightfall Modifiers

displayProperties.description: Attach a mod to a weapon to improve or add to its perks.
displayProperties.name: WEAPON MODS

displayProperties.description: Blessings provided by the Traveler, allowing Guardians to harness the abundant energies present in its Pale Heart. The blessings are only effective within the Pale Heart.
displayProperties.name: Destination Mods

displayProperties.description:
Perks that modify your character's abilities and consume Aspect energy.

Visit the Exo Stranger on Europa to unlock more of these perks.
displayProperties.name: FRAGMENTS

displayProperties.description: Perks are built into a given piece of armor. They cannot be swapped out.
displayProperties.name: ARMOR PERKS

displayProperties.description:
Abilities that slot into your character's build.

Purchase more abilities from Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
displayProperties.name: ABILITIES

displayProperties.description: Perks are built into a given Ghost Shell. They can be swapped out an unlimited number of times.
displayProperties.name: GHOST SHELL PERKS

displayProperties.description: Attach a mod to a Ghost Shell to improve or add to its perks. Doing so consumes the mod.
displayProperties.name: GHOST SHELL MODS

displayProperties.description:
Abilities that grow your build and provide energy to Fragments.

Visit the Exo Stranger on Europa to unlock more of these abilities.
displayProperties.name: ASPECTS

displayProperties.description: View the different types of ingredients available during the Dawning.
displayProperties.name: Ingredients

displayProperties.description: Attach a mod to a Ghost shell to improve it.
displayProperties.name: GHOST MODS

displayProperties.description: Clan Perks are enabled when you belong to a clan that has reached the indicated clan level for that season.
displayProperties.name: Clan Perks

displayProperties.description: Staves are rewarded for reaching the maximum clan level each season.
displayProperties.name: Clan Staves

displayProperties.description: The base qualities of a weapon.
displayProperties.name: INTRINSIC TRAITS

displayProperties.description: Perks are built in to a given weapon. They can be swapped out an unlimited number of times.

displayProperties.name: VEHICLE MODS

displayProperties.description: Unlocked from Masterworking your Ghost shell.
displayProperties.name: Activity Ghost Mod

displayProperties.description: Unlocked from Masterworking your Ghost shell.

displayProperties.description: …in circles. Ancient enemies return to plague old battlegrounds. Time moves…
displayProperties.name: Season of the Undying

displayProperties.description: Re-entwine the strands of time on Mercury and ignite the flames of hope.
displayProperties.name: Season of Dawn

displayProperties.description: A new season has begun! Roam the Tangled Shore, avenge the fall of a legend, and walk the right side of wrong in Gambit.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Outlaw

displayProperties.description: A new season has begun! Rediscover the glories of the past and acquire beautiful new instruments of destruction.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Forge

displayProperties.description: A celebration of the Guardian Tenets, the Guardian, and the perseverance of the human spirit.
displayProperties.name: Monument of Triumph

preview.description: Get the Rewards Pass and instantly wield the Exotic Hand Cannon, Turncoat! Along with XP bonuses, score bonus boosts, and premium rank rewards.

displayProperties.description: In the aftermath of the Witness's attack, the Vanguard calls upon its closest allies. The Guardian must master the righteous powers of the Awoken to stand against the encroaching Shadow Legion and prove themselves as Queensguard.
displayProperties.name: Season of Defiance

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the Exotic Combat Bow, Verglas Curve. Also get XP boosts and access to seasonal activities to earn new rewards.

displayProperties.description: Delve into the depths of Titan's methane sea in search of lost technology and knowledge.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Deep

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the Exotic Auto Rifle, Centrifuse. Also get XP boosts and access to seasonal activities to earn new rewards.

displayProperties.description:
Savathûn's Ghost Immaru has approached the Vanguard with a dire bargain: the Witch Queen holds the information we need to pursue the Witness and will share it with us if we first contend with her sister, Xivu Arath. 

Through the power of arcane rituals, the Guardians must gather tithes for Eris Morn so she can fulfill this dangerous pact with the Hive god of lies.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Witch

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the Exotic Grenade Launcher, Ex Diris. Also get XP boosts and access to seasonal activities to earn new rewards.

displayProperties.description: Return to the Dreaming City and aid Queen Mara in making one last wish.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Wish

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the Exotic Rocket Launcher, Dragon's Breath. Also get XP boosts and access to seasonal activities to earn new rewards.

displayProperties.description:
As the system reels in the wake of the events of the Final Shape, an unknown object impacts Nessus. 

Guardians must venture deep into the mysterious core of Nessus and deal with an awakening threat wielding an incredible and terrifying new power.
displayProperties.name: Episode: Echoes

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the Exotic Pulse Rifle, Red Death Reformed. Also get XP boosts and access to seasonal activities to earn new rewards.

displayProperties.description:
All is not well for the Eliksni. A paracausal curse is slowly corrupting Mithrax, the leader of House Light, while an old threat has re-emerged to plague the system with a new breed of Revenant Scorn.
 
With Eido's help, Guardians face a kinetic battle against the renewed Scorn, and a metaphysical one for the fate of Mithrax's soul.
displayProperties.name: Episode: Revenant

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the Exotic Grenade Launcher, Alethonym. Also get XP boosts and access to seasonal activities to earn new rewards.

displayProperties.description:
The Dreadnaught returns. Powerful Taken threaten to overwhelm the system.

To survive the onslaught, the Guardians must learn the secrets of Taken power—and harness them.
displayProperties.name: Episode: Heresy

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the Exotic Pulse Rifle, Lodestar. Also get XP boosts and access to seasonal activities to earn new rewards.

displayProperties.description: As the Vanguard unravels a cosmic mystery on the edge of the system, the Forces of the City battle to reclaim territory closer to home.
displayProperties.name: Season: Reclamation

preview.description: Get the Rewards Pass and instantly wield the Exotic Pulse Rifle, New Malpais! Along with XP bonuses, score bonus boosts, and premium rank rewards.

displayProperties.description: The Almighty bears down on the Last City. Join forces with unlikely allies to avert this crisis and destroy the last vestige of Cabal power in the system.
displayProperties.name: Season of Arrivals

displayProperties.description: With the Almighty bearing down on the Last City, Guardians from all walks of life unite to bring all their power to bear against the Cabal sun-killer and forge new bonds with old rivals.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Worthy

displayProperties.description: Battle Empress Caiatl's forces and prove your strength against the champions of the Cabal.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Chosen

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the new Seasonal armor set and the new Solar Bow, Ticuu's Divination. You also get an XP boost that speeds up your Seasonal ranks and engram unlocks.

displayProperties.description: As the Pyramids send the system into chaos, Guardians must work with unexpected allies to hunt the monstrous forces of Xivu Arath and unravel the Hive god's network of mysterious cryptoliths.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Hunt

displayProperties.description: Savathûn has been brought out of hiding, revealing a harrowing discovery that shakes the Vanguard. As Xivu Arath prepares to capture her sister, Savathûn offers you a bargain: free her from her worm, and she will reveal the truth about the Darkness.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Lost

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the new Exotic Linear Fusion Rifle. Also get XP boosts that speed up Seasonal ranks and reward track unlocks.

displayProperties.description: As the Last City is consumed by an Endless Night, Guardians must hack their way through the Vex Network with help from Mithrax, the Sacred Splicer.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Splicer

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the new Exotic Stasis Sidearm. You also get XP boosts that speed up your Seasonal ranks and reward track unlocks.

displayProperties.description: The prison ship of the exiled Cabal Emperor Calus has returned. But its reappearance heralds the beginning of the end as the once-dormant lunar Pyramid stirs to life once more. With the aid of Eris Morn's witchcraft, the Guardian must work with Empress Caiatl, Commander Zavala, and Crow to unravel the mysteries of the Leviathan and the lunar Pyramid and stop Calus before it is too late.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Haunted

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the new Exotic Sidearm. Also get XP boosts that speed up Seasonal ranks and reward track unlocks.

displayProperties.description: When Savathûn's Lucent Hive threaten the source of the Guardians' power, survival depends on the fragile alliance between the Vanguard and Empress Caiatl. Wielding a spear imbued with Light-suppressing technology, the Guardian must work with Lord Saladin and Caiatl's most trusted Psion to search for secrets in the minds of the Lucent Hive and stop their ghoulish plans.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Risen

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the new Exotic Machine Gun. Also get XP boosts that speed up Seasonal ranks and reward track unlocks.

displayProperties.description: Assist Ana Bray and Osiris in finding a way to restore the Warmind, Rasputin, in order to combat the enemies of Sol.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Seraph

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the Exotic Submachine Gun, The Manticore. Also get XP boosts and access to seasonal activities to earn new rewards.

displayProperties.description: Eramis, Kell of House Salvation, has broken free from her icy prison on Europa. As she rallies the old Pirate Lords of Eliksni legend, the Guardian must assemble a motley crew of their own and retrieve powerful relics of Darkness before they fall into Eramis's hands.
displayProperties.name: Season of Plunder

preview.description: Get the Season Pass and instantly unlock the Exotic Fusion Rifle, Delicate Tomb. Also get XP boosts and access to seasonal activities to earn new rewards.

displayProperties.description: A new season has begun! Choose what kind of Guardian you will become. Reckon with the path that lies ahead.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Drifter

displayProperties.description: A new season has begun! Venture into the Infinite Forest, uncover the mysteries of Osiris, and seek new challenges on Mercury.
displayProperties.name: Curse of Osiris

displayProperties.description: A new season has begun! Search for relics of the past, learn the secrets of Rasputin, and unearth things long forgotten beneath the frozen surface of Mars.
displayProperties.name: Resurgence

displayProperties.description: A new season has begun! Lavish yourself in gifts from the mighty Emperor Calus. Seek lost treasures throughout the system.
displayProperties.name: Season of Opulence

displayProperties.description: After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.
displayProperties.name: Radiolaria Breach

displayProperties.description: While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
displayProperties.name: Collective Power

displayProperties.description: Briefly guard with a Sword to ready Blade Focus. While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.
displayProperties.name: Blade Focus

displayProperties.description: Sword hits return grenade and class energy. Bonus energy is granted if Blade Focus is active.
displayProperties.name: Combat Meditation

displayProperties.description: Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.
displayProperties.name: Reflex Action

displayProperties.description: Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.
displayProperties.name: Hotshot

displayProperties.description: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.
displayProperties.name: Old Martian Diplomacy

displayProperties.description: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.
displayProperties.name: High Noon

displayProperties.description: Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.
displayProperties.name: Augmented Armaments

displayProperties.description: Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.
displayProperties.name: Augmented Explosives

displayProperties.description: Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.
displayProperties.name: Opening Act

displayProperties.description: Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.
displayProperties.name: Room Clearing

displayProperties.description: While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.
displayProperties.name: Melee Conduction

displayProperties.description: Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.
displayProperties.name: Regenerative Threshold

displayProperties.description: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
displayProperties.name: Resonance Redirection

displayProperties.description: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
displayProperties.name: Stable Resonance

displayProperties.description: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.
displayProperties.name: Knit Together

displayProperties.description: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.
displayProperties.name: Sinew Stitching

displayProperties.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, your next final blow grants additional ammo progress and creates an Orb of Power.
displayProperties.name: Resupply

displayProperties.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, slowly gain Frost Armor until you reenter combat.
displayProperties.name: From the Storm

displayProperties.description: After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.
displayProperties.name: Ascendant Escape

displayProperties.description: Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.
displayProperties.name: Iron Sharpens Iron

displayProperties.description: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
displayProperties.name: Siphoning Touch

displayProperties.description: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
displayProperties.name: Resonant Plating

displayProperties.description: Picking up an ammo brick heals you.
displayProperties.name: Crook and Flail

displayProperties.description: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.
displayProperties.name: Gift of Sight

displayProperties.description:
Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time.

This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.
displayProperties.name: Repurposed Charge

displayProperties.description: When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.
displayProperties.name: Emergency Electromagnet

displayProperties.description: You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
displayProperties.name: Wrecker

displayProperties.description: Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.
displayProperties.name: Concussive Rounds

displayProperties.description: Taking significant damage in a short time generates a Protective Wish that makes it harder for combatants to hit you, and grants increased reload speed and flinch resistance.
displayProperties.name: A Wish for Protection

displayProperties.description:
When the Protective Wish expires, it cures you. 

Rapid final blows prematurely end the Protective Wish.
displayProperties.name: A Wish Fulfilled

displayProperties.description: Performing a finisher on powerful combatants heals you and generates loyal Void moths.
displayProperties.name: Lucent Tithes

displayProperties.description: Performing a finisher on a combatant, or landing successive powered melee final blows, generates an Elemental pickup based on your Light subclass.
displayProperties.name: Lucent Transmutation

displayProperties.description: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.
displayProperties.name: Bad Dreams

displayProperties.description: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.
displayProperties.name: Dream-Devourer

displayProperties.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.
displayProperties.name: Between Poles

displayProperties.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.
displayProperties.name: So Very Thin

displayProperties.description: Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony. While it is active, ability final blows occasionally spawn allied Arc moths.
displayProperties.name: Lucent Swarm

displayProperties.description: Finishing combatants or reviving allies initiates a Lucent Hive ritual. While the ritual is active, gain increased Super stat.
displayProperties.name: The Ceremony

displayProperties.description: Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed. Taking more damage increases the effect.
displayProperties.name: Built Bitter

displayProperties.description: When you stow a weapon, restore health based on the number of Built Bitter stacks lost.
displayProperties.name: Bittersweet

displayProperties.description: Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets, and radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
displayProperties.name: Doppler Effect

displayProperties.description: Picking up an ammo brick gives you a stacking bonus to weapon swap and stow speeds until you die.
displayProperties.name: Accretion

displayProperties.description: Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.
displayProperties.name: Unfaltering Focus

displayProperties.description: Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.
displayProperties.name: Iaido

displayProperties.description: Once per activation of Force Converter, sprinting while at critical health, being suspended, or being slowed by a Stasis effect will immediately grant Speed Booster for a short duration.
displayProperties.name: Reactive Booster

displayProperties.description: After a final blow with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile, sprint for a short time to gain Speed Booster.
displayProperties.name: Force Converter

displayProperties.description: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.
displayProperties.name: Untold Greed

displayProperties.description: While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.
displayProperties.name: Overflowing Coffers

displayProperties.description: Powered melees release an additional disorienting pulse when used to defeat a target.
displayProperties.name: Augmented Servos

displayProperties.description: When your shields are broken by a combatant, or upon casting your Super, release a swarm of heat seeking micro-missiles.
displayProperties.name: God-like Judgment

displayProperties.description: Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.
displayProperties.name: Well Prepared

displayProperties.description: Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.
displayProperties.name: Down the Line

displayProperties.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Special ammo progress.
displayProperties.name: Power Loader

displayProperties.description: Final blows with primary ammo weapons grant your primary ammo weapons temporarily increased reload speed.
displayProperties.name: Terminal Velocity

displayProperties.description: Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.
displayProperties.name: Truth to Power

displayProperties.description: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.
displayProperties.name: Queensfoil Rush

displayProperties.description: When you reach critical health or heal an ally at critical health, Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms gain a period of increased range, stability, and reload speed.
displayProperties.name: Magnificent Duty

displayProperties.description: Reloading an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm after a final blow slowly restores health until you reenter combat.
displayProperties.name: Pleas Heard

displayProperties.description: When an ally is defeated, Primary ammo weapons gain increased handling, reload speed, target acquisition, and reduced flinch. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
displayProperties.name: Primary Survivor

displayProperties.description: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons remove you from radar for a short time. Drawing a weapon that does not use Primary ammo will immediately end this effect.
displayProperties.name: Primary Phantom

displayProperties.description: Fast movement builds up a charge that gradually increases your health regeneration speed. Once you are Fully Revved, sprinting grants Speed Booster.
displayProperties.name: Revving Up

displayProperties.description: Sliding while Speed Booster is active jolts combatants in front of you.
displayProperties.name: Dielectric Drift

displayProperties.description: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.
displayProperties.name: Shock and Clear

displayProperties.description: While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
displayProperties.name: Ionic Overclock

displayProperties.description: When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.
displayProperties.name: Reactive Shock

displayProperties.description: Final blows with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile temporarily decrease incoming area-of-effect damage.
displayProperties.name: Force Absorption

displayProperties.description: Defeating targets with unique elemental damage grants a stacking bonus to Transcendence energy gains while Transcendence is inactive.
displayProperties.name: Stack 'Em Up

displayProperties.description: While Transcendence is active, using your grenade ability consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant an escalating amount of grenade energy.
displayProperties.name: Burn 'Em Down

displayProperties.description: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
displayProperties.name: Ride Together, Die Together

displayProperties.description: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
displayProperties.name: Too Old for This

displayProperties.description: Primary ammo weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to mobility and Primary weapon range and handling until you are defeated.
displayProperties.name: Primary Chain

displayProperties.description: Increases mobility and grants enhanced sprint speed and slide distance.
displayProperties.name: Sublime Transit

displayProperties.description: As your health gets lower, your weapons gain increased stability and handling. Weapon final blows while your shields are depleted heal you.
displayProperties.name: Vigilant Watch

displayProperties.description: When your shields become broken, you gain increased ammo generation, flinch resistance, and damage resistance against nearby combatants for a short time. Final blows extend this effect.
displayProperties.name: Iron Conviction

displayProperties.description: Your weapons gain a temporary increase to handling and aim-down-sights speed when an ally is defeated or you revive an ally.
displayProperties.name: Martingale

displayProperties.description: Primary ammo weapons gain a bonus to flinch resistance after sliding.
displayProperties.name: Paroli

displayProperties.description: After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.
displayProperties.name: Superluminal Motion

displayProperties.description: Picking up ammo reloads stowed Special weapons from reserves.
displayProperties.name: Special Relativity

displayProperties.description: Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.
displayProperties.name: Suros Harmony

displayProperties.description: Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.
displayProperties.name: Fanfare

displayProperties.description: While Adrenal Rush is active, final blows grant Special Ammo progress. Final Blows against powerful combatants, Guardians, and Taken grants additional progress.
displayProperties.name: Bountiful Munitions

displayProperties.description: Sprinting for a short time grants a period of improved reload speed and handling. Final blows extend this period.
displayProperties.name: Adrenal Rush

displayProperties.description: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
displayProperties.name: Nightmarish Resilience

displayProperties.description: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
displayProperties.name: Nightmarish Power

displayProperties.description: When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.
displayProperties.name: Rapid Repair

displayProperties.description: While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type.  Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.
displayProperties.name: Built from Scratch

displayProperties.description: Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.
displayProperties.name: Primary Honing

displayProperties.description: Final blows while your Super is active refund Super energy when it ends.
displayProperties.name: Supercyclical

displayProperties.description: While you have Initiative, using your class ability creates a stationary healing aura. The aura gains increased healing based on the number of Initiative stacks.
displayProperties.name: Healing Initiative

displayProperties.description: Hitting combatants with melee attacks or Sword strikes grants a stack of Initiative, giving bonus handling and reload. Stacks decay slowly over time.
displayProperties.name: Taking Initiative

displayProperties.description: Grenade final blows grant additional Heavy ammo progress.
displayProperties.name: Taken Armaments

displayProperties.description: Grenade final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage.
displayProperties.name: Taken Barrier

displayProperties.description: Melee final blows trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion.
displayProperties.name: Cursed Fist

displayProperties.description: Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.
displayProperties.name: Power of the Son

displayProperties.description:
Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. 

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
displayProperties.name: Balestra

displayProperties.description: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.
displayProperties.name: Stesso Tempo

displayProperties.description: Receiving healing temporarily grants your Solar weapons increased flinch resistance, handling, and reload speed.
displayProperties.name: Photogalvanic

displayProperties.description: Rapid Solar final blows heal you.
displayProperties.name: Cauterize

displayProperties.description: After collecting a Void breach, your next final blow with a Void weapon triggers a detonation. The detonation is more powerful if it is triggered quickly after collecting a Void breach.
displayProperties.name: Techeun's Foresight

displayProperties.description: Rapidly defeating combatants with Void energy spawns a Void breach.
displayProperties.name: Gift of the Ley Lines

displayProperties.description: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.
displayProperties.name: Network Upload

displayProperties.description:
Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.
displayProperties.name: Network Admin

displayProperties.description: Precision final blows while aiming down sights grant damage resistance until you stop aiming down sights.
displayProperties.name: Watchtower

displayProperties.description:
Precision final blows with any weapon grant a stacking bonus to reload speed, target acquisition, and weapon damage against non-boss combatants for a short duration.

Weapon final blows with non-precision direct hits end this effect early.
displayProperties.name: Field Expertise

displayProperties.description: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.
displayProperties.name: Scoot to Loot

displayProperties.description: Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.
displayProperties.name: Shoot to Scoot

displayProperties.description: Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.
displayProperties.name: Lethal Weave

displayProperties.description: Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.
displayProperties.name: License to Thrill

displayProperties.description: Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.
displayProperties.name: Rasputin's Wrath

displayProperties.description:
While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
displayProperties.name: Rasputin's Reprisal
